name: Hills Hoist
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const angle=mt*0.3; const hlh=50; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; svg += `<line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="${-hlh}" stroke="#888" stroke-width="3"/>`; for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ const a=angle+i*Math.PI/2; const ex=Math.cos(a)*28; const ey=-hlh+Math.sin(a)*8; svg += `<line x1="0" y1="${-hlh}" x2="${ex}" y2="${ey}" stroke="#AAA" stroke-width="1.5"/>`; const clothSway=Math.sin(mt*1.5+i*1.1)*3; const clothCols=['#FF6B6B','#4ECDC4','#FFD166','#9370DB']; svg += `<rect x="${ex/2-3}" y="${(-hlh+ey)/2}" width="6" height="5" rx="1" fill="${clothCols[i]}" opacity="0.8" transform="rotate(${clothSway} ${ex/2} ${(-hlh+ey)/2})"/>`; } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
